summary: iter77 — Tested sticky mobile CTA, admin sticky CTA card, SEO Insights panel, best-value badge math, and player-voice free preview. All backend tests pass (7/7). All frontend flows verified successfully. No console errors on landing (mobile & desktop) or admin.

design_issues.screen: Admin → SEO & Social → Article Keywords & Views table
issues: On desktop viewport (1440px), article titles overlap the keyword-chips column visually (see screenshot). Titles like 'From Grassroots to Academy: A Realistic Roadmap for Ambitious Young Players' render into the neighbouring column area. Consider a max-width or truncation on the title cell, or moving keyword chips below the title row.

action_items: (Minor / optional) Constrain the Article column width in SEO admin table so long titles don't visually overlap the Keywords column at desktop widths.
critical_code_review_comments: value-line copy in the review request says '≈ $15.00 each' for Premium, but code uses toFixed(2) on 29.99/2 = 14.995 which renders as '≈ $14.99'. Rendered text is '$14.99', not '$15.00'. Numeric result is arguably correct; if $15.00 is desired, wrap in a rounding helper.
FreePreviewLanding.jsx: selfPlayer check uses simple first-name equality — will misfire if account holder happens to share first name with a different player (edge case). Acceptable for MVP.
StickyPricingCTA IntersectionObserver has generous 160px rootMargin on both sides — mildly aggressive; works well in practice on the test viewport.

Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter77_sticky_seo.py covers: GET/PUT /api/settings/sticky-cta + PUT /api/admin/sticky-cta auth, GET /api/admin/seo/insights auth+shape (returned 7 articles + 8 cached suggestions this iteration), GET /api/settings/price sanity, GET /api/demo-report regression. Playwright confirmed: sticky CTA text 'GET MY REPORT', wrap opacity toggles correctly with pricing-section IntersectionObserver, badge only on VIP (value-line premium = '2 reports/mo ≈ $14.99 each — save 88%', vip = '4 reports/mo ≈ $12.50 each — save 90%'), admin sticky CTA card + SEO panel render fully with 7 article rows and 8 cached suggestions (no re-click). Player-voice preview: 'your game' + 'your biggest strength' present, no 'Noah's game' / 'his game' / 'the player'. NO real emails sent (created_at=NOW).
